title: Lost, then found: transient forgetting in humans and machines
title_zh: 丢失，然后找回：人类与机器中的暂时性遗忘
abstract: Forgetting can be permanent or transient. An intriguing, recently described form of transient forgetting (TF) in artificial neural networks is the stability gap: a network that has already learned a first task exhibits transient yet substantial forgetting when it begins additional training on a second task alongside the first. Could an analogous phenomenon be found in humans? Following a literature survey, six types of TF in humans were identified, categorised by their sources: learning, retrieval, spontaneous, overgeneralisation, task-switching, and multitasking. Although all differ in important ways from the stability gap, it is hypothesised that some underlying mechanisms are shared. This opinion article concludes by proposing experiments to test whether a 'stability gap-like' form of TF also occurs in humans.
abstract_zh: 遗忘可以是永久的或暂时的。在人工神经网络中，一种最近描述的暂时性遗忘（TF）形式是稳定性差距：一个已经学习了第一个任务的网络，在开始在第一个任务的同时训练第二个任务时，会出现暂时的、实质性的遗忘。人类中是否存在类似的现象？经过文献调查，识别出六种人类的TF类型，按其来源分类：学习、检索、自发、泛化过度、任务切换和多任务。虽然它们与稳定性差距有重要区别，但假设某些潜在机制是共享的。本观点文章通过提出实验来测试人类是否也存在类似‘稳定性差距’的暂时性遗忘形式来结束。
